title: Hukam inside the ordinary day
subtitle: For acceptance that must become lived trust
description: These readings bring Hukam out of concept and into receiving, acting, and surrendering without arguing with the shape of the day.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Hukam is not a theory beside life; it is the order within which giving, receiving, loss, and action happen.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Receive the next circumstance as something to meet faithfully, not as a verdict against you.

evidence.coreClaim: This journey teaches acceptance as lived obedience under Hukam.
evidence.turn: The day becomes less hostile when it is met inside divine order rather than private resistance.
evidence.practicalImplication: Name what has been given, then choose the faithful action available inside it.
